title: Mica At Home

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: I wonder, will today be a good day?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wonder, will today be a good day?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How did you get in here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How did you get in here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How did you get in here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How did you get in here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I doubt it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I doubt it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I doubt it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I doubt it.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: I'm fortunate enough to have feet upon which I walk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm fortunate enough to have feet upon which I walk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I mean how'd you get in my apartment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I mean how'd you get in my apartment?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, I mean how'd you get in my apartment?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, I mean how'd you get in my apartment?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Benefit of being 'Sec. Now we get to chat without the busy bustle of the streets around us, drowning out words, twisting meanings. Just a nice, easy chat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Benefit of being 'Sec. Now we get to chat without the busy bustle of the streets around us, drowning out words, twisting meanings. Just a nice, easy chat.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Chat? I don't want to chat with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Chat? I don't want to chat with you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Chat? I don't want to chat with you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Chat? I don't want to chat with you.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Honey, the answer to that question depends on you. And your attitude.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Honey, the answer to that question depends on you. And your attitude.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not helping you. But you already knew that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not helping you. But you already knew that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not helping you. But you already knew that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not helping you. But you already knew that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You have nothing on me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have nothing on me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You have nothing on me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You have nothing on me.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: We need to talk seriously. I know someone cleansed your record. You might be clear from 'Sec, for now, but you're not clear of me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We need to talk seriously. I know someone cleansed your record. You might be clear from 'Sec, for now, but you're not clear of me.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Look, you recently went on a run for a friend of yours. Eddy? Tell me a little about that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, you recently went on a run for a friend of yours. Eddy? Tell me a little about that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No idea what you're talking about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No idea what you're talking about.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No idea what you're talking about.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No idea what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want with Edison?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want with Edison?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want with Edison?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want with Edison?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It was on my way home.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was on my way home.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It was on my way home.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It was on my way home.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, I brought some take away from the stand to a friend of his. So?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I brought some take away from the stand to a friend of his. So?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, I brought some take away from the stand to a friend of his. So?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, I brought some take away from the stand to a friend of his. So?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Even if that were the case, and we both know that it's not, you're telling me you wouldn't use a HOVA-dasher?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Even if that were the case, and we both know that it's not, you're telling me you wouldn't use a HOVA-dasher?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: In the opposite direction? Care to try again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In the opposite direction? Care to try again?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: As much fun as this has been (thank you for having me) I'm afraid we're going to need to wrap it up. You know, things to do, work never ends because people never stop dying.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As much fun as this has been (thank you for having me) I'm afraid we're going to need to wrap it up. You know, things to do, work never ends because people never stop dying.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright, here's what I know...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, here's what I know...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Alright, here's what I know...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Alright, here's what I know...

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: That's it. Let that weight off your shoulders. Welcome to the right side of the fold.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's it. Let that weight off your shoulders. Welcome to the right side of the fold.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Well. They say stupidity is contagious. I guess hanging around with that deadbeat smuggler has done a number on you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well. They say stupidity is contagious. I guess hanging around with that deadbeat smuggler has done a number on you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, Mica. I can't help you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, Mica. I can't help you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry, Mica. I can't help you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry, Mica. I can't help you.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Don't worry, once I leave you'll be wishing I was still here. But, before I go, let me give you one more chance to make this easy on yourself: tell me where Edison Mattix is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't worry, once I leave you'll be wishing I was still here. But, before I go, let me give you one more chance to make this easy on yourself: tell me where Edison Mattix is.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The door's right there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The door's right there.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The door's right there.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The door's right there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Noooo! Please stay. This has been so much fun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Noooo! Please stay. This has been so much fun.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Noooo! Please stay. This has been so much fun.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Noooo! Please stay. This has been so much fun.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: I know all about Edison's little network. Like a primitive version of adaptive marketing software, trying to bend and twist and reach new consumers while leaving those behind hollowed out and broken.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know all about Edison's little network. Like a primitive version of adaptive marketing software, trying to bend and twist and reach new consumers while leaving those behind hollowed out and broken.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Besides the fact that he poisoned over half-a-dozen people and left the blame on you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Besides the fact that he poisoned over half-a-dozen people and left the blame on you?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Mhm. And if I took a look inside your neurons? Cracked your skull like the shell of a crustacean and analyze the meat inside?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mhm. And if I took a look inside your neurons? Cracked your skull like the shell of a crustacean and analyze the meat inside?

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Edison Mattix needs to understand that people are given a lot in life and they need to adapt to that lot. Trying to pull them out of it or change it goes against the code running this program.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Edison Mattix needs to understand that people are given a lot in life and they need to adapt to that lot. Trying to pull them out of it or change it goes against the code running this program.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Helping his niece? He doesn't have a niece. He's running a trafficking network to take a cut of the gen debt he's erasing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Helping his niece? He doesn't have a niece. He's running a trafficking network to take a cut of the gen debt he's erasing.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: That money is owed to different players. Banks, corps, even 'Sec gives out some loans if you're desperate enough for 74.6% API to sound appealing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That money is owed to different players. Banks, corps, even 'Sec gives out some loans if you're desperate enough for 74.6% API to sound appealing.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: I know, right? Personally, I'd rather cut my own arm off than sign on that dotted line. There are plenty that do though. See, that's the problem: everyone thinks they're a few good months from hitting big when the truth is they're a few bad days from sleeping under a bridge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know, right? Personally, I'd rather cut my own arm off than sign on that dotted line. There are plenty that do though. See, that's the problem: everyone thinks they're a few good months from hitting big when the truth is they're a few bad days from sleeping under a bridge.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Edison gets paid, and his client's competition loses a shit-ton of Lims. Not that hard to figure out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Edison gets paid, and his client's competition loses a shit-ton of Lims. Not that hard to figure out.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: That's an option, albeit not a good one. If you think having the poisoning of a handful of people is too much, just wait. I'll line your life with guilt, death, and debt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's an option, albeit not a good one. If you think having the poisoning of a handful of people is too much, just wait. I'll line your life with guilt, death, and debt.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You better get out of here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You better get out of here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You better get out of here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You better get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Tale it easy. Hear me out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tale it easy. Hear me out.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: He's skirting the law and skimming off the top. Think about it: someone winds up with a mound of Gen Debt. Sorry parents, you're out of luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's skirting the law and skimming off the top. Think about it: someone winds up with a mound of Gen Debt. Sorry parents, you're out of luck.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Then, the competition will say something like, "we'll pay you five percent of their gen debt if you make them disappear."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then, the competition will say something like, "we'll pay you five percent of their gen debt if you make them disappear."

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Competition. He courts other lenders, gives them a report of who's moving through his network, who they owe and how much.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Competition. He courts other lenders, gives them a report of who's moving through his network, who they owe and how much.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whatever.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Whatever.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not naive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not naive.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not naive.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not naive.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: Let's hope that is so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's hope that is so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't expect you would give up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't expect you would give up.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I didn't expect you would give up.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I didn't expect you would give up.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: And why would I? My duty extends beyond my orders.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And why would I? My duty extends beyond my orders.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A misunderstanding.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A misunderstanding.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A misunderstanding.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A misunderstanding.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: And those he "helped" can then be exploited. Nobody knows they still exist.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And those he "helped" can then be exploited. Nobody knows they still exist.

nodes.speaker: Mica Rain
nodes.text: I'll be back in a few days. Then either your decision has changed - or your life will change drastically.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll be back in a few days. Then either your decision has changed - or your life will change drastically.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Still doesn't explain why you're looking for him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Still doesn't explain why you're looking for him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Still doesn't explain why you're looking for him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Still doesn't explain why you're looking for him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you really want with Edison?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you really want with Edison?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you really want with Edison?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you really want with Edison?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're mad he's trying to help his niece?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're mad he's trying to help his niece?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're mad he's trying to help his niece?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're mad he's trying to help his niece?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't understand.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't understand.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't believe you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't believe you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't believe you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't believe you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 75% interest?!?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 75% interest?!?!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: 75% interest?!?!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: 75% interest?!?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How does Edison make money off this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How does Edison make money off this?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How does Edison make money off this?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How does Edison make money off this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not buying it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not buying it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not buying it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not buying it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This is too much.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is too much.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This is too much.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This is too much.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And if I don't tell you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And if I don't tell you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And if I don't tell you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And if I don't tell you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't believe it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't believe it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't believe it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't believe it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I see.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I see.
